newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-QUINNELL THIRD INJURED LION TO GO HOME.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-QUINNELL THIRD INJURED LION TO GO HOME.

text.p: Welsh number eight Scott Quinnell became the third injured British Lion to be sent home in the space of a week on Monday after a recurring groin injury ended his tour of South Africa.
"He is having problems with a groin injury which has flared up again and the tour management decided to send him home this morning," Lions media liaison officer Bob Burrows said.
"Sadly, Scott is the third player -- after Paul Grayson and Doddy Weir -- that we've had to send home from this tour in only one week."
Quinnell, who had impressed in his early tour appearances, was a front runner with England's Tim Rodber for the number eight berth in the upcoming test series against South Africa.
Burrows said the Lions management committee would meet on Monday night to discuss a replacement for Quinnell.
